### workspace tmux --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace tmux show [--name NAME] [--json]

  show    A workspace's tmuxinator file as session fields, windows and panes

Examples:
  workspace tmux show    # the current directory's workspace: windows and panes as a summary
  workspace tmux show --name myproject    # a named workspace, from anywhere
  workspace tmux show --name myproject --json    # the same as one JSON document, for a script
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace tmux show --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace tmux show [--name NAME] [--json]

Show a workspace's tmuxinator file (~/.config/tmuxinator/workspace.<name>.yml) as
session fields, windows and panes. Each pane has its command, a kind (claude,
agentd, banner, shell or command) and its line in the file; when the session is
running, each pane also has its tmux pane id and start command. Read-only: an
edit to the file takes effect the next time the session is launched.

Options:
        --name, --project NAME       Workspace to show instead of the one inferred from cwd
        --json                       Print one document (see docs/README.tmux.md)

Examples:
  workspace tmux show    # the current directory's workspace: windows and panes as a summary
  workspace tmux show --name myproject    # a named workspace, from anywhere
  workspace tmux show --name myproject --json    # the same as one JSON document, for a script
--- stderr
--- end
